title: Lesson Calendar - Draft Lesson - Right Menu - Matches PBT-2340 Draft Screenshot
description: Validate that menu layout status presentation and action set for Draft lesson match the Draft screenshot attached in PBT-2340.
preconditions: - Logged in as HQ or CM Staff on Salesforce calendar.\n- A lesson with status Draft exists on calendar day view.\n- PBT-2340 ticket attachments are accessible for visual reference.
steps_actions: 1. Open PBT-2340 and identify the Draft-status screenshot in attachments.\n2. Open Lesson Calendar and select a Draft lesson card then open right-side menu.\n3. Compare actual menu/status display with attachment baseline.
steps_result: 1. Draft reference screenshot is opened and usable as expected baseline.\n2. Right-side menu for Draft lesson is displayed in calendar context.\n3. Menu composition and status presentation match Draft screenshot baseline and Publish Lesson is visible.
steps_data: 1. source = PBT-2340 attachment (Draft)\n2. lesson_status = Draft\n3. compare_mode = visual_parity
suite: Publish Lesson Menu in Lesson Calendar
